_comment: Records whose official address or title research disproved, but whose programme is real. Correcting these is not the same as retiring them: a rotted link must not hide a live scholarship.
_rules: Every entry must say what was wrong with the stored value and where the correct value came from.
URLs are absolute http/https only. A correction that does not resolve is worse than the 404 it replaces.
Retiring a record is a separate, stronger decision and lives in retired_records.json. It is only for programmes that no longer exist, never for a broken link.
Allowed fields: title, official_source_url, application_link, official_source, description.
